analogy.rationale: Melatonin receptors (MT1/MT2) are Gi-coupled GPCRs expressed at very low levels in most of these cell lines, so melatonin receptor agonists should elicit little to no transcriptional response; the closest reference class is the melatonin receptor antagonist, which acts on the same receptors, while other GPCR ligands are only weakly similar.
